# Harry Magic: Potions Class

> Potion making game for iPhone and iPad. The player is a first-year at a wizard school and pours exact recipes into a cauldron against a one-minute timer.

## Key facts

- Who it is for: kids and fans of wizard school stories. App Store age rating 4+.
- Price: free download, the first six classes are free, one purchase opens the full course ($2.99 in the US). No ads, no subscription.
- Platforms: iPhone and iPad, iOS 18 or later. Plays without internet. 35 languages.
- Content: ten Potions classes with an exam, Mixology color classes, eight potions, sixteen medals.
- Independent game, not an official Harry Potter product.
- App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/id6809835630
